scenes.title: Companion Intelligence
scenes.caption: Your browsing, saved to a Memory you run.
scenes.narration: The services holding your history do not keep it for you. This extension saves it to your own Companion Memory.

scenes.caption: One sign-in. It finds your Memory.
scenes.narration: You sign in once through your CI-Portal account, and the extension looks for your Memory there. It follows your system's light or dark setting.

items.alt: The extension popup on a dark system: Remember everything you browse, with a Sign in with CI-Portal button.
items.label: Dark system

items.alt: The same popup on a light system.
items.label: Light system

scenes.title: What it saves
scenes.caption: Four things. Three have their own switch.
scenes.narration: It saves the pages you visit, your bookmarks and downloads, and any passage you highlight. The first three each get their own switch.

scenes.title: 13 sites, filed as what they are
scenes.caption: Titles and dates, not anonymous visits.
scenes.narration: Thirteen sites get their own profile, so what you watched, read or booked is filed as titles and dates. Each runs only on its own site.

items.label: Streaming
items.value: Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Paramount+, Prime Video

scenes.title: You decide what is saved
scenes.caption: Ignore a site and nothing from it is uploaded.
scenes.narration: Ignore any site or page and nothing from it is uploaded. Pause capture whenever you like. The extension never asks for cookie access.

scenes.title: Where it goes
scenes.caption: Your Memory gets the data. CI-Portal gets who you are.
scenes.narration: Captures go to your Memory. Sign-in goes through CI-Portal, which learns who you are, never what you saved. Crash reports are anonymous, with one switch to turn them off.

scenes.title: Companion Intelligence

scenes.narration: Keep your history yours, with the Companion Intelligence browser extension. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
